title: Read a JSON request
summary: Flask: Read a JSON request. Send an empty object.
introduction: Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}. The code checks that the body is an object with text title.
learningObjectives: Read a JSON request with Flask

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Read a JSON request

blocks.text: get_json reads the object. Its title is a string, so the created response branch is selected.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check parsed data before indexing into it.
